item.title: Hideo Kojima Is Blown Away by AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH and It’s Fueling His Next Creative Push
item.description: Hideo Kojima has always worn his love of cinema on his sleeve, and longtime fans have learned to read between the lines of his social media movie reactions. A few polite sentences usually mean a film didn’t quite land for him. A long, passionate post means the opposite. That’s exactly what happened after he watched Avatar: Fire and Ash, the latest chapter in James Cameron’s epic sci-fi saga.Kojima took to X with a response that made it clear Cameron’s third Avatar film left a serious impression.
